messages:
harper_pm: Quick kickoff for the Mar webinar social plan. Goals: max signups from X + LinkedIn, capture qualified leads for SDRs, and surface a short benchmark narrative in the follow-up. Timeline: assets by Thu AM, schedule Wed/Thu posts, day-of push Fri.
leo_social: I'll handle X thread (teaser + day-of push + highlight thread). Need hero JPG (1200x675), 30s clip, and 1 quote card. Can we deprioritize a carousel?
tasha_design: Team overloaded but can deliver hero + quote card by Thu 10am if it's just one quote card. Clip would be a stretch unless we repurpose an existing recording.
sylvia_gtm: Reuse last month's webinar clip? Could we snip a 30s highlight from the demo section. Eli, can ops extract that fast?
eli_ops: Yes, we can export a 30s clip from the raw recording and host it on CDN. Need timecode. Ops can do it within 4 hours of receiving timecodes.
leo_social: I'll draft 3 short X openers (A/B) and one LinkedIn variant with a stat. Aim for Wed scheduling: teaser Wed 09:00 PT, LinkedIn Thu 11:00 PT, final X Fri 07:00 PT.
harper_pm: Benchmarks: ask eng for one line (latency/cost) to put in highlight thread. If not available, we'll phrase it as "real-world perf wins".
sylvia_gtm: For lead routing: require company, role, and email on form; tag contacts: source=organic_social, campaign=mar-webinar. Bayes: add utm_source param. UTM_BOT, please suggest naming.
utm_bot: Suggested UTM params: utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=webinar_mar2026, utm_source=x_teaser / x_final / linkedin_post. Shorten links via rwd.in.
sylvia_gtm: Great. SDR handoff: create smart view in HubSpot: contact property webinar_mar2026 = true. SDRs will triage hot leads within 24h.
leo_social: Quick note on tone: X teaser = playful/short, LinkedIn = professional + one concrete stat. I'll include a CTA "Save your spot" + short link.
tasha_design: Drop the final assets into the shared drive and name files: webinar_mar_hero.jpg, webinar_quote.png, webinar_clip_30s.mp4. I'll upload by Thu 10am.
eli_ops: Ops will set the form to add contact to list: webinar_mar2026_attendees and fire webhook to HubSpot. Also enable logging for source attribution.
harper_pm: Approval flow: sylvia_gtm for GTM, harper_pm for product. Once both sign-off, leo can queue posts.
leo_social: I'll post drafts in this thread by Wed noon for quick feedback.
sylvia_gtm: Reminder: add UTM to registration link so we can break down conversions by channel. Also include a hidden field for "account_tier" if possible.
harper_pm: One more ask: can we run a small promo to engineering newsletter? Might help lift qualified signups. If yes, add utm_source=eng_newsletter.
sylvia_gtm: Good idea. I'll coordinate.
leo_social: All right, I'll drop the copy options in here. Thanks team. :party_parrot:
